The font is unmodified. ansi-ui.mjs embeds those exact bytes for offline
reconstruction; it does not depend on a third-party font request at runtime.
The source documentation recommends16px or integer multiples for faithful
pixel outlines. The named CSS/Canvas face is GhostVGA. This name registers
the unmodified source asset; no synthetic bold/italic variant is shipped.
